findings: The frame17 dump contains only 5 path-3 image payload uploads, all to DBP pages 11541, 11104, 11576, 10662, and 11575.

The 143 ROI draw references from the full vertex trace use persistent TEX0 pages such as 14208, 14176, 12384, 5632, 15744, 15616, 12448, 14944, 14352, 13824, and 11424; none map to an in-frame upload at the same DBP.
The local upper-strip groups remain tbp0=12384/tbp0=12448 with psm=2 and 128x32/128x16 TEX0 dimensions, and also have no in-frame upload owner.

No image payload hash matched the decoded source BMP payload variants, and a direct byte search of the GS state did not find raw decoded gem_star/line01/tail_tight/tail2/gem payloads; persistent texture ownership likely requires GS-state/VRAM layout decoding, not transfer-event matching alone.
patch_reason: Texture ownership for the normal-tail body is still not proven; renderer tail UV/material changes would still be guesswork.
